_note: TEMPLATE — the committed default. For a real run, copy this to restaurant.local.json (git-ignored) and fill it in there so the admin password never reaches the repo. setup.mjs uses restaurant.local.json when it exists, otherwise this file. Blank / null values are skipped.

admin.//: If the account still says 'must change password', put a new one in newPassword and the script sets it. If you already changed it in the app, put that password above and leave newPassword empty.

//tables: Set { "count": N } to create tables 1..N, or an explicit list like ["1","2","A1"]. null skips tables (add them by hand in the app).
//stewards: Waiter names for the order screen's picker, e.g. ["Kamal","Nimal"]. [] skips them (the owner adds them on site).
